# Pattern Studio

> Free browser-based custom sewing pattern maker for fashion designers, seamstresses and cosplayers. 24 garments, 90 design styles, drafted from the user's own measurements; nesting, yardage, size runs XS–3XL, DXF/SVG/PNG export, designer croquis and photoreal renders on women's and men's models in the exact fabric. Fabric catalogue and checkout by Blue Moon Fabrics (Los Angeles Fashion District). Built by Siamak Kalhor Consulting.

## Pages
- [How Pattern Studio works — from silhouette to cut-ready pattern](https://studio.siamakconsulting.com/how-it-works): Five steps: choose a garment, pick a design style, enter your measurements, choose the fabric, generate. You get a drafted pattern with seam allowance, grain lines and notches, a nested cutting layout, yardage, a designer croquis and a photoreal render on a model.
- [24 garments, 90 styles — Pattern Studio catalogue](https://studio.siamakconsulting.com/garments): Every garment Pattern Studio drafts, with its design styles, measurement fields and pattern pieces: Bikini Top, Bikini Bottom, One-Piece Swimsuit, Swim Dress, Leggings, Sports Bra, Leotard, Unitard / Catsuit, Crop Top, Bodycon Dress, Maxi Dress, Nightgown / Slip Dress, Two-Piece Set, Jumpsuit, Skirt, Shorts, Lingerie / Bodysuit, Costume / Couture, Wrap Dress, Rash Guard / Swim Top, Biker Shorts, Corset Top, Tennis Dress, Board Shorts.

- [Pattern Studio for fashion designers, seamstresses & small brands](https://studio.siamakconsulting.com/designers): A free, browser-based drafting assistant for designers and seamstresses: parametric patterns from measurements, size runs XS–3XL, nesting and yardage, DXF for industrial cutters, and client-ready renders on a model.
- [Pattern Studio pricing — free to draft, $35/month for Pro](https://studio.siamakconsulting.com/pricing): Draft patterns, see the croquis and three photoreal renders free. Pattern Studio Pro is $35/month: unlimited renders on women’s and men’s models, DXF and SVG export, size runs XS–3XL and unlimited cloud projects. Cancel anytime.
- [Pattern Studio FAQ — formats, measurements, men’s patterns, renders](https://studio.siamakconsulting.com/faq): Answers about Pattern Studio: what you get, which measurements you need, DXF/SVG exports, men’s and women’s models, render accuracy, phones and commercial use.
- [About Pattern Studio](https://studio.siamakconsulting.com/about): Pattern Studio is a free browser-based custom sewing pattern maker for designers, seamstresses and cosplayers, created by Siamak Kalhor Consulting with Blue Moon Fabrics of the Los Angeles Fashion District.
